say:1:1310217001:0.text: The Snowspire Festival's opening ceremony is about to begin!
say:1:1310217001:0.source_cn: 冬日祭典开幕式即将开始！冬日祭典开幕式即将开始！

say:2:1310217002:0.text: Everyone, please make your way to the town square... Hey, don't push! Be careful!
say:2:1310217002:0.source_cn: 各位朋友，请移步镇中广场……哎、哎，大家不要挤，小心点！

say:5:1310217003:0.text: Wow, the opening ceremony's finally beginning! Magister, let's hurry and get a good spot!
say:5:1310217003:0.source_cn: 哇，开幕式！主人，快，咱们去占个好位置！
